biography:
Test Card is a Vancouver, British Columbia electronic music project associated with dub techno and atmospheric home-recorded production. The project’s Bandcamp page identifies it as a Vancouver artist, and a profile on The Slow Music Movement notes that Test Card made the first release on the label, with the music recorded at home in Vancouver, Canada.

Test Card’s work reflects a patient, immersive approach to electronica, drawing on the spacious rhythms and textured ambience that define dub techno. An Apple Music release titled Microtonal Drones (2017) suggests an interest in extended tones and minimal, experimental structures, which fits the project’s understated, exploratory character.
